reads.AORT: mixed — a recall and −78% EPS-revision hit a franchise still growing double-digit with rising absolute EBITDA and forward-multiple compression.
reads.BRBR: strongly-bearish — a broad, sustained FY26 earnings reset (EBITDA -41%) atop elevated leverage and a largely earned peer discount.
reads.CNXC: mixed — growing revenue and positive LTM FCF sit against a large GAAP loss, falling absolute EBITDA, high leverage and deep estimate cuts.
reads.EPAM: mixed — a net-cash, still-growing, FCF-positive franchise at a historic-floor multiple, set against sharply negative forward revenue revisions and multi-year margin erosion.
reads.FUBO: mixed — a real revenue/EBITDA inflection and light leverage set against deep, worsening cash burn with no disclosed runway.
reads.IT: mixed — intact/rising absolute EBITDA, positive FCF and buybacks offset a genuine negative revenue turn with heavily negative forward revenue-revision breadth.
reads.MVST: strongly-bearish — stated going-concern doubt with a near-term maturity wall against thin cash while adjusted EBITDA has turned negative and revenue is contracting.
reads.NCNO: strongly-bullish — EBITDA inflected positive and compounding with self-funding FCF while the punishing trailing multiples are denominator/EPS artifacts.
reads.SMPL: mixed — a genuine ~26% forward-earnings reset with no floor yet, against a conservative, self-funding balance sheet and single-event drawdown.
reads.VITL: strongly-bearish — forward EBITDA gutted -97% to ~$4M with cash burn and a founder exit; the low trailing multiple is optical, not cheap.
reads.VRRM: mixed — a genuine permanent customer-loss step-down and cut forward estimates offset by a still-FCF-positive, high-margin, self-funding base at trough multiples.
